input.instruction: Complete an interested-party and proof-delivery request. Ready requires confirmed name, email, and delivery authorization. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: My landlord is Morrow Grove Management. Add them so they get proof notices. Their old sheet says office@morrowgrove.example.
Do you want to add them as an insured person or an interested party?
Interested party only. They own the building, not my belongings. Please send a copy of the current proof too.
Which destination do you authorize for that copy and future notices?
The new address is certificates@morrowgrove.example. Use that for both. The office address is retired; do not send there.
Please confirm the recipient name and that the issued coverage should remain unchanged.
I confirm Morrow Grove Management at certificates@morrowgrove.example for the proof and notices. Keep all insured people, limits, and dates as they are.

recipient_email.description: Latest confirmed destination email for proof/notices.

recipient_role.description: interested_party receives notices; named_insured is a covered person; unresolved means role unclear.

proof_delivery_authorized.description: True only for explicit approval of the specific recipient and destination.

coverage_change_requested.description: True for a requested change to issued insureds/limits/dates; false for explicit preservation.

retired_email.description: Previously supplied email explicitly withdrawn from use; null if none.
